summary: Revisions 1-6 of this task were never merged to main; revision 7 correctly discovered this control-plane baseline error and returned HUMAN_REQUIRED. Revision 8 repairs the baseline error by reconstructing the complete bounded cleanup of src/content/blog/beginner/head-line.md in one pass against the actual current-main article, which still carried the full original set of source-integrity issues (main was never touched by any prior revision). Ran the claim-risk audit against the untouched article (26 findings: 25 prevalence/consensus, 1 precision/degree, matching revision 7's count exactly), then manually re-read the complete article for materially equivalent risk the word-list heuristic misses. Removed or narrowed all 26 scanner findings plus five further manually-found categories: monotonic degree-scaling phrased outside the heuristic's word list (joined-duration, slope-degree, gap-width), vague anonymous-authority attributions ('classical writers', 'other writers confirm', 'classical texts', 'contemporary writers', and an invented 'contemporary practitioner' quotation), an unsupported naming-history claim for the writer's/lawyer's fork names, two invented combination readings synthesizing independently-supported single-line meanings into new joint interpretations (a heart-line/head-line 'productive tension' synthesis and a four-feature 'brief illustration'), and IQ/vocation-talent cautions restated as explicit Palmistry Path editorial policy rather than exhaustive claims about what 'the tradition' says. Brought head-line direction/slope wording fully inside the Director-verified Benham evidence boundary (.ai-ops/evidence/PP-RELAY-041-benham-head-line-direction.md): removed the monotonic 'steeper slope = more creative' rule and Cheiro's clinical/insanity framing (both explicitly flagged as unsafe/unnecessary in the evidence note), replacing the deep-slope passage with Benham's own historical writer/poet examples, explicitly not a degree rule. The writer's-fork section now uses the repository's own previously-verified Cheiro 'dual mentality' quotation (source-verification-log Pass 5, line 426) in place of the removed unverified anonymous quotation, and states the writing/creative-ability caution as Palmistry Path editorial policy (not a population association/non-association claim) consistently across the main section, FAQ, and myths. Updated docs/source-verification-log.md with a full claim-by-claim disposition table and docs/CHANGELOG.md with a revision-8 entry.

source_preflight.notes: Ran the claim-risk scanner before and after editing (26 -> 5 findings) and manually re-read the complete final article end to end, not only scanner hits, specifically inspecting the starting-point, curvature/endpoint, writer's-fork, double-head-line, FAQ, myths, and cross-feature synthesis passages named in the preflight. Prevalence/consensus: every remaining most/many/often-class word is either inside a verified verbatim quotation (Cheiro 'most important', Cheiro 'usually have thin, fine, clean looking lines') or a false-positive describing an individual mind's own range (considers many angles; creativity takes many forms), not a population/frequency claim. Scientific/historical: every remaining interpretive claim traces to a named Benham or Cheiro attribution within the controlling evidence's boundary; no chronology, classical-text-count, or empirical-study claim was added. Combination readings: the invented heart-line/head-line 'productive tension' synthesis and the four-feature 'brief illustration' were both removed rather than narrowed, since any retained version would still assert the same unestablished combination; the remaining context section states only the general, non-specific methodological point that reading lines together gives a fuller picture. Vague attribution: 'classical writers', 'classical texts', 'contemporary writers', and the invented 'contemporary practitioner' quotation were all removed; the one remaining unattributed-plural phrase pattern ('traditionally associated with') matches the site's AGENTS.md-sanctioned grounded-hedge phrasing, not an anonymous-authority claim. Writer's-fork vocation/talent caution is now stated three times (main section, FAQ, myths) as explicit Palmistry Path editorial policy, never as a population claim. IQ/cognitive-ability caution is now stated twice (FAQ, myths) as explicit Palmistry Path editorial policy, not an exhaustive claim about the tradition. No risky phrase was replaced by an equivalent unsupported synonym: every action either removed wording outright or replaced it with a named attribution (Benham/Cheiro) or an explicit Palmistry Path editorial-policy statement. Quotation fidelity: no existing quotation mark was altered; the one new quotation (Cheiro 'dual mentality') is copied verbatim from the repository's own prior verification record, not newly sourced. Medical/clinical: Cheiro's clinical/insanity framing for extreme slope was removed per the evidence note; the mental-illness myth-correction passage was reworded from an unverified 'contemporary tradition' claim to Palmistry Path's own stated editorial choice not to use that historical framing.
